properties.title: Effort to regulate ‘killer robots’ delayed to 2028
properties.summary: U.N. talks on regulating AI-powered killer robots ended without a negotiating mandate Saturday, as countries decided to extend discussions until 2028. It’s a result that NGOs called “disappointing.” Countries party to the U.N.’s Convention on Certain Conventional Weapons spent five days in Geneva trying to reach an accord to elaborate legally binding rules for weapons that can select and attack targets without human approval. properties.title: Turkey: Activists chant 'shame' as COP31 negotiations falter
properties.summary: Climate activists denounced the proposed outcome of COP31 in Antalya, Turkey, on Friday 20 November 2026, accusing governments of failing to deliver meaningful progress on tackling climate change. They chanted "shame" as negotiations approached their deadline.

properties.title: Germany presses to make Ukraine aid Le Pen-proof
properties.summary: BERLIN — Germany is pushing to lock a durable funding scheme for Ukraine into the EU’s next long-term budget that will be difficult for potential opponents such as Marine Le Pen to veto should she win next year’s French presidential election. properties.title: EPP moves to suspend Serbia’s former ruling party
properties.summary: The center-right European People’s Party leadership decided Wednesday to suspend the Serbian Progressive Party, the political home of former Serbian President Aleksandar Vučić. The move comes after the Serbian party, also known as SNS, lost the October 2026 general elections , ousting Vučić, its de facto leader and the country’s president for nine years.
